feeding_claim.verbatim: It means our cattle are never fed grain. They spend their lives on fresh pasture, eating only grass and forage.

availability.note: Site says grass-fed beef is currently sold out.

notes: Family farm on more than 240 acres at Sunset, also known for pecan products and honey. Checked the about page, the where to find our products page, and the ground beef product page. The about page says the farm raises grass-fed, grass-finished cattle and pasture-raised chickens and that cattle are never fed grain. Beef is reserved through a Google Form, with $10 local delivery in the Lafayette area and local pickup in Lafayette; the product page shows grass-fed beef as sold out. Eggs are sold only at named Lafayette area retailers (Drug Emporium, Sandra's, Champagne's Market and others). Pecan products, honey and an Amazon storefront are not meat, eggs or dairy and were left out. Do not add an organic label from the farm name; the organic match script should decide. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary, not raw text. The farm also sells on reach.dog, which was not used.
